item.title: Spring Break Starts at The Village Door
item.description: March just got louder at John Wehner’s Village Door. Located in The Village Of Baytowne Wharf in Sandestin, the ultimate spring break party spot is turning up the heat with a stacked DJ lineup all month long. A Star-Studded Lineup The Village Door welcomes back local favorites DJ Fox and DJ Vladi, plus nationally recognized DJ and Siesta Key star Brandon Gomes. Gomes, known for his appearance on MTV, brings serious star power and even bigger beats to the dance floor.

item.title: Caring &amp; Sharing Spring Fashion Show at Hilton Sandestin March 29
item.description: Join Caring &amp; Sharing of South Walton for the Spring Fashion Show, presented by Emerald Coast Hospice, on Sunday, March 29th, 2026, at the Hilton Sandestin Beach Golf Resort &amp; Spa. The benefit event promises an afternoon of fun, fashion, and community support, featuring a fashion show, lunch, music, a silent auction, a photo booth, and much more.

item.title: Kids Fishing Tournament &amp; Fun Day at Topsail Hill Preserve State Park April 18
item.description: The 2nd Annual Reeling in the Emerald Coast - Conservation Day is coming to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park on Saturday, April 18, 2026. This free family event, hosted by the park and Walton County 4-H, combines outdoor adventure with hands-on learning for the next generation of coastal stewards. The highlight for many young anglers is the Kids Fishing Tournament. Registration begins at 9:00 AM, and lines go in the water from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM.

item.title: Emerald Coast Theatre Company Presents “Mystic Pizza” April 30 - May 17
item.description: Friendship, love, and small-town dreams take center stage as Emerald Coast Theatre Company (ECTC) closes its thirteenth season with Mystic Pizza. The beloved coming-of-age story runs from April 30 through May 17, with performances scheduled Thursday through Saturday at 7 p.m. and matinees on Wednesdays and Sundays at 2 p.m. at ECTC’s theater in Grand Boulevard at Miramar Beach.

item.description: Join the SoWal community at Alys Beach on Good Friday, April 3rd, for the annual Good Friday Crawfish Boil, featuring a refined take on a Gulf Coast tradition. Purchase tickets TODAY for this family-friendly event: Alys Good Friday Crawfish Boil It’s the perfect way to kick off the Easter weekend activities — relaxed, festive, and full of flavor.
